# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure at Rosemont Bakery

**Report ID:** RB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 14–15, 2024
**Prepared by:** Facilities & Operations Review Team
**Distribution:** Owner, Store Manager, Head Baker, Facilities Contractor, Insurance Carrier

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 11:47 PM on March 14, 2024, the walk-in cooler at Rosemont Bakery experienced a compressor failure during a period of high ambient load. The failure went undetected until staff arrived at 4:30 AM the following morning. By that time, internal cooler temperatures had risen from a normal 38°F to 61°F, resulting in the loss of approximately $4,200 worth of perishable inventory, including custards, cream-filled pastries, buttercream cakes, and dairy products. No products were sold to customers, and no public health incident occurred.

This report reconstructs the timeline, examines the contributing factors, and recommends changes to reduce the likelihood of recurrence. The review team emphasizes that this incident resulted from a combination of system design gaps and organizational factors—not from the failure of any individual employee.
